why: Collects the sideways reading nowhere, so `measureHitTargets` hands the verdict an overflow object with only the dead `page` field on it. The verdict answers that with a failure rather than a pass, but nothing would hold this line in place on its own -- and a reading that is never collected is the same blind spot as a reading that can never fire.
killedBy: hit-sweep.mjs: handing the sideways reading to the verdict collects the sideways reading and puts it on the overflow object it returns
